text:
Morgan H: Morning — trying to stitch two release lanes tomorrow into one coordinated wave. Target window 09:00 PDT. Need owners for svc-auth and inference-proxy smoke runs. Who can take those slots?
Samir: I can own svc-auth smoke and rollback readiness. Will be on call at 08:30 PT to prep. :thumbsup:
Tasha: I’ll take inference-proxy canary + smoke. Planning a small canary (5% traffic) for first 20m, then full when green.
Leo: I’ll watch metrics and traces during the wave. Can toggle routing if latency spikes.
Rhea: FYI I'll lock the DB migration window at +1h after deploy, so please avoid schema changes in the first pass.
Samir: quick Q — do we want to run the full integration smoke (billing + auth + embeddings) or keep it focused on health endpoints?
Tasha: let’s keep it focused: auth, proxy health, and one end-to-end embedding call. If that passes, we run the integration + billing in the follow-up slot.
Morgan H: Good. Can we add a short rollback plan in-thread? If any of these fail we should be able to rollback to the last pinned tag within 15m. Samir — you ok with v2.6.4 as safe rollback for svc-auth?
Samir: yes, v2.6.4 is validated. I’ll prepare the quick rollback playbook and share the commands in thread.
deploy-bot: Reserve confirmed: release-wave window 2026-05-14 09:00 PDT — 09:45 PDT (deploy-bot)
Tasha: copying the smoke checklist here:
```bash
# smoke checks (run after deploy)
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/inference-proxy --timeout=3m
curl -fS https://inference.prod/_health || true
# sample inference test
curl -sS -X POST https://inference.prod/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' | jq .
```
Rhea: metrics to watch:  p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, roam-token error spikes (>0.5% triggers rollback). Also memory OOMs on inference-proxy.
Leo: I’ll create dashboards and set short-term alerts for the wave (thresholds as Rhea said). Adding a small trace sampling increase for the canary.
Samir: rollback commands (svc-auth):
```bash
# rollback to v2.6.4
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/svc-auth svc-auth=registry/redwood/svc-auth:v2.6.4
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/svc-auth --watch
```
Tasha: inference-proxy rollback is just flipping the deployment tag back to `release-20260503` — I’ll keep that tag pinned.
Morgan H: timing check — 08:30 prep, 08:45 pre-smoke run dry, 09:00 canary deploy (5% -> 20m), 09:20 evaluate -> 09:30 full deploy if good. Agree?
Samir: sounds good. I’ll post the playbook and add myself to the release call.
Tasha: I’ll add the smoke owner checklist to the wave doc and ping infra to hold capacity for the canary.
Morgan H: Thanks all — please react with :eyes: when you’ve read and :white_check_mark: when you’re confirmed on the slot.
Leo: :eyes:
Samir: :white_check_mark:
Tasha: :white_check_mark:
Rhea: :eyes:
